title: Senate race in once reliably Republican South Carolina tied in final stretch – poll
summary_full: Democrat Annie Andrews neck-and-neck with Republican incumbent, Darline Graham, sister to Lindsey GrahamUS politics live – latest updatesA US Senate race in one of the most Republican states in the country is now a dead heat, according to a new poll showing Annie Andrews, a Democrat, tied with Darline Graham, the Republican incumbent senator.South Carolina has not elected a Democrat to the Senate since 1998, and Donald Trump won it by nearly 18 points in 2024, but a New York Times/Siena poll this week has the two candidates neck and neck, at 48% each.
